items.summary: Research question: catalog polymeric entities shown to cross the BBB.
Entity class in scope: polymeric entities.
Core property: crossing the blood-brain barrier.
Define 'crossing' via evidence tiering keyed to assay directness (in situ brain perfusion strong; CSF sampling weaker).
ML task = binary classification (crosses / does-not-cross). regression on a continuous permeability value is the alternative.
Negative-data policy: include polymeric entities reported as NOT crossing. Load-bearing for classification; 'shown to cross' framing is positive-only.
Six-level evidence-tier ordinal by assay directness (see evidence-tier doc)..
'Crosses' = a derived label requiring evidence at/above a ratified minimum tier (+ optional quantitative cutoff per assay)..
items.edit_note: 'crosses' = evidence at/above tier T3; T4–T5 recorded, not sufficient alone — RATIFIED gate 2

items.summary: Entity identity: model the crossing entity as a COMPOSITE formulation (polymer + size + surface modification + cargo) vs. the bare polymer..
Polymer identity bindings (EXISTING standards): BigSMILES line notation; CRIPT polymer data standard; PoLyInfo. Monomer/cargo: SMILES + InChIKey. Nano reporting: eNanoMapper / MIRIBEL..
Conditioning variables: species/model, administration route, dose, polymer Mw/Mn/PDI, architecture, particle size (nm), zeta potential (mV), surface ligand/targeting moiety, cargo..
Unit of analysis: one row = one (entity, assay/measurement, condition-set, source)..
Provenance granularity: explicit measurement_instance_id (same entity recurs across assays/conditions/papers)..
Source scope: literature adapter over the CNS-nanomedicine corpus; optional structured adapter if a curated nano-BBB dataset is named..
Inclusion: measured (not predicted) crossing evidence; in vivo and in vitro admissible but tiered; exclude pure in-silico from the positive set..

Add bbb_state field (intact/disrupted/unspecified). Rationale: spot-check found 11/60 ML-ready rows were crossings of a pathologically disrupted BBB (TBI/tumor), a different claim from intact-BBB crossing. Proposes segregating them. REQUIRES RATIFICATION: whether disrupted-BBB crossings are out of scope is a domain-scope decision only the researcher makes.
items.ratification_note: Researcher-ratified: disrupted-BBB crossings are 'cheating but still useful' — retain in database, segregate/flag, exclude from default intact-BBB view.

items.summary: Add delivery_bypasses_bbb field (no/yes_intranasal/yes_other). Rationale: spot-check found 8/60 rows used intranasal delivery, which reaches the CNS via olfactory/trigeminal routes without crossing the vascular BBB. Proposes excluding them from BBB-crossing evidence. REQUIRES RATIFICATION: whether nose-to-brain is out of scope is a domain-scope decision.
items.ratification_note: Researcher-ratified: nose-to-brain (intranasal) bypass is 'cheating' — retain in database, segregate/flag as out_of_scope_route, exclude from default intact-BBB view.
